name: google-cloud-monitoring
description: Official Google Cloud Monitoring remote MCP server for listing alerts and alerting policies, running PromQL queries, reading time series and metric descriptors, and browsing dashboards in a Google Cloud project. Google does not support automatic client registration, so you must provide your own OAuth client credentials: in the Google Cloud console, enable the Cloud Monitoring API, grant everyone who will connect the MCP Tool User role (roles/mcp.toolUser), create an OAuth client (web application), and add Devin's OAuth callback URL (https://api.devin.ai/mcp/oauth/callback, or the equivalent for your Devin environment) as an authorized redirect URI. Then enter the OAuth client ID and secret when installing this server.
